jobPosting: Heavy Equipment Operator -- Aggregate and Paving. Kalispell MT. Operate skid steer, roller, excavator and haul truck on highway and county road projects. Requires CDL Class A. MSHA Part 46 required. Flagger certification preferred. Daily equipment inspection, greasing and preventive maintenance. Crusher pit experience a plus. Traffic control and flagging. Grading, pipe laying and concrete experience preferred. Welding ability a plus.
